links.outcome: Agreement of PCI planning decisions with expert record, RAG-enhanced CA-GPT versus general ChatGPT-5
links.effect: Pre-PCI median agreement score 5 (IQR 3.75-5) for CA-GPT vs 3 (2-4) for ChatGPT-5 (P<0.001); post-PCI 5 (4.75-5) vs 4 (4-5) (P<0.001).
links.quote: For pre-PCI planning, CA-GPT demonstrated significantly higher median agreement scores (5[IQR 3.75-5]) compared to both ChatGPT-5 (3[2-4], P<0.001) and junior physicians (4[3-4], P<0.001).

screen.reason: The study evaluates a specialized RAG-enhanced AI system (CA-GPT) compared to a general LLM and junior physicians for OCT-guided PCI decision-making on retrospective patient data, focusing on model performance rather than testing an organizational deployment safeguard.
